step1_analysis.description: A common-source amplifier with a PMOS active load and an NMOS switch for auto-zeroing. During the auto-zero phase, the switch connects the drain and gate of the amplifying NMOS to store the offset on an input capacitor. During the amplification phase, the switch opens, and the circuit acts as a high-gain preamplifier for a comparator in the flash ADC sub-block.

paper_reference.title: A 100-MS/s 8-b CMOS Subranging ADC with Sustained Parametric Performance from 3.8 V Down to 2.2 V

power_consumption.description: DC power dissipation of the preamplifier stage.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the exact PMOS bias voltage applied. Scaled down for 1.8V SKY130 process.

dc_gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain of the preamplifier during the amplification phase.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported, typically 20-40 dB for flash ADC preamps.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm1 = sqrt(2 * un*Cox * (W/L) * Id) = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 57u) = 0.55 mS. ro = 1 / (lambda * Id) = 1 / (0.1 * 57u) = 175 kOhm. Rout = ro_n || ro_p = 87 kOhm. Gain = gm1 * Rout = 48 V/V = 33 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using standard square-law models for SKY130 parameters.

unity_gain_bw.description: Frequency at which the voltage gain drops to 0 dB (1 V/V).

paper_reported.value: ADC operates at 100 MS/s, requiring >500 MHz bandwidth.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = gm1 / (2 * pi * C_load). Assuming 50 fF load: 0.55 mS / (2 * pi * 50 fF) = 1.75 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is highly dependent on the load capacitance of the subsequent latch stage.

auto_zero_trip_point.description: The DC voltage at the input/output nodes when the auto-zero switch is closed.

sky130_expected.calculation: Vgs of NMOS to sink 57 uA: 57u = 0.5 * 270u * 10 * (Vgs - 0.42)^2 -> Vgs = 0.62 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the NMOS threshold voltage and bias current.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, and transient auto-zero/amplification behavior.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Auto-zeroed Comparator Preamplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

XM1 N1 N2 LABEL_NET_0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 LABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 LABEL_NET_5 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9

* Switch control: DC 0 for AC analysis, Pulse for Tran
* Pulse: ON (1.8V) for 10ns, then OFF (0V) for 80ns
V_sw LABEL_NET_5 0 DC 0 PULSE(1.8 0 10n 1n 1n 80n 100n)

* Input signal: DC 0.6V, AC 1V, Step 10mV at 60ns
V_in Vin_node 0 DC 0.6 AC 1 PULSE(0.6 0.61 60n 1n 1n 40n 100n)
C_in Vin_node N2 1p

* DC feedback resistor for AC analysis (acts as open circuit for Tran due to 10G * 1p = 10ms time constant)
Rbias N1 N2 10G

* Load capacitor to simulate next stage
C_load N1 0 50f

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8 - i(VLABEL_NET_1) * 1.8
print power
print v(N1) v(N2)

* 2. AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1k 10G
let gain_db = vdb(N1) - vdb(N2)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
meas ac unity_gain_freq when gain_db=0 fall=1

* 3. Transient Analysis
tran 0.1n 100n
* Measure auto-zero voltage (switch is ON)
meas tran v_az find v(N1) at=5n
* Measure output base voltage before step (switch is OFF)
meas tran v_out_base find v(N1) at=55n
* Measure output peak voltage after step (switch is OFF)
meas tran v_out_peak find v(N1) at=80n

quit
.endc
.end
